content.text:
Perfect! All 250 tests pass ✓

**Added duplicate customer merge feature:**

**New error code in src/errors.js:**
- `SAME_CUSTOMER` — cannot merge a customer with itself

**New function in src/customers.js:**
- `mergeCustomers(customers, invoices, fromId, intoId)` — consolidates duplicate customer records
  - Returns `ok({ customers, invoices })` where:
    - customers array has fromId customer removed
    - invoices array has all fromId invoices transferred to intoId
  - Validates both customer IDs exist (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
  - Prevents self-merge (SAME_CUSTOMER)
  - Normalizes customer IDs (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed)
  - Maintains input immutability
  - Preserves all invoice fields except customerId

**Tests added: 14 tests covering**
- Removing fromId customer from array
- Transferring all invoices from fromId to intoId
- Preserving invoices from unaffected customers
- Error handling: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND (either customer missing)
- Error handling: SAME_CUSTOMER (attempting self-merge)
- ID normalization (case-insensitive and with whitespace)
- Input immutability (no mutations to original arrays)
- Multiple invoices per customer transfer
- Preservation of other invoice fields (number, status, total, etc.)
- Empty invoices array
- Customer data integrity (names, emails preserved)
